description: This bar chart illustrates Shapley values for different linguistic probes across several model layers. The horizontal axis represents the model layer, labeled L₀ through R₄⁺, and is ordered sequentially from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Shapley value,” has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 20-unit intervals. Four sets of bars are presented for each layer, representing the models XLM, XLM-R, chLSTM, and T, each distinguished by a unique color: dark blue, medium blue, light green, and gray, respectively. For layer L₀, the Shapley values are approximately 1.5 for XLM, 1.8 for XLM-R, 0.8 for chLSTM, and 1.2 for T. In layer R₄⁺, the values are approximately 42 for XLM, 48 for XLM-R, 52 for chLSTM, and 44 for T. The bars are grouped by layer, with each model represented by a bar within that group; the height of each bar corresponds to the Shapley value for that model and layer. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated.
